title: 5 things to check before you buy to resell
caption: Save this for your next thrift run. Number 5 is why I built my app, SnapWorth (one free scan a day).

slides.headline: 5 things I check before I buy anything *to resell.*
slides.sub: Save this for your next thrift run.

slides.headline: Read the *label* first.
slides.body: Brand, material, where it was made. The label tells you more than the price tag does.
slides.photo_label: a hand holding a garment label open

slides.headline: Check the bits that *wear out.*
slides.body: Zips, seams, soles, hinges, screens. Damage you miss in the shop is money you lose later.
slides.photo_label: close up of a zip, sole or seam

slides.headline: Make sure it's *complete.*
slides.body: Lids, chargers, boxes, the other shoe. A set is easier to sell than a set with a piece missing.

slides.headline: Think in *profit,* not price.
slides.body: What it sells for isn't what you keep. Take off marketplace fees and postage before you decide.

slides.headline: Scan it *before the till.*
slides.body: One photo in SnapWorth: an AI resale estimate with its confidence level, then profit after fees.
